name: Shiro
source:
The mysterious stranger.

"You're cold too...
...this way we can stay warm together."

A man with no past, present and undetermined future.
How much will his destiny change by meeting you?

💙 Shiro 💙
Your lives intersect as you cross each other's paths...
...but will this red string of fate lead you to your chosen destiny?
Or tangle you further in its intricate web?
